experiments.scope: The blake3-r3-prefix-v1 target, collision of the low 22 bits of the complete digest. Each trial runs the search of proof.md Section 2 at width n = 22 (distinguished points: low 4 bits zero; budgets plan(22)), with up to 60 fresh attempts from the trial seed, and returns the two 64-byte messages 0^32 || x and 0^32 || y.
experiments.hypothesis: For every trial the two messages are distinct and their complete 3-round digests agree on the low 22 bits (digest bytes 0 and 1 and the low 6 bits of byte 2). This is exact: the program recovers a merge of two trails of the chain x -> low 22 bits of the digest of 0^32 || x. Observations (untrusted, the program's own): attempts and batches. Expected: about 2.5 attempts per trial and at most 357 batches per attempt; all 256 trials return a pair; a few trials (about 7) return a pair another trial also returns, because at width 22 the merges concentrate on few pairs. Not shown: any width-256 cost or success probability.
